title: Problem priority
description: How the framework ranks a venture's customer problems and what holds its problem tree together (EE-219), at packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/problem-priority.json. The weights are unvalidated priors a venture replaces under problems in naive.config.json; the labels are a view of the computed order and are never stored on a problem.

used_for.description: What in Naive this standard governs, so a reader can tell the parts apart

weights.description: The weight on each evidence count from the validation interviews (validation-interview.schema.json problems). Unvalidated priors.

ranked_statuses.description: The statuses a problem must have to be in the ranking; one with any other status is listed with its status and no rank

labels.description: The label for each rank, from that rank onward: primary at 1, secondary at 2, tertiary at 3 and below

requires_target.description: The record types that are written only once the primary profile's core problem and the venture's target problem exist. The fail-closed rule of packages/naive/src/checks/check-problems.ts

records.description: Record types in data-model.json, whose venture paths say which files wait
